content_html:
The Sacred Valley of the Incas is one of Peru’s most fascinating destinations. Located just outside Cusco, it combines Andean landscapes, traditional villages, and archaeological sites that played a key role in Inca civilization.

If you have limited time in Cusco, spending one full day in the Sacred Valley is an excellent choice.

Must-see places in the Sacred Valley

Pisac

Famous for its archaeological site and traditional market.

  • Impressive Inca terraces
  • Artisan market (great for souvenirs)

Entrance fee:
Included in the Cusco Tourist Ticket

Ollantaytambo

One of the best-preserved Inca towns in Peru.

  • Inca fortress with massive terraces
  • Original Inca streets
  • Main gateway to Machu Picchu

Entrance fee:
Included in the Cusco Tourist Ticket

Chinchero

Living tradition and Andean textiles.

  • Archaeological site
  • Traditional textile workshops
  • Colonial church

Entrance fee:
Included in the Cusco Tourist Ticket

Prices and tickets

Cusco Tourist Ticket (partial – Sacred Valley):

  • Approximate price: S/ 70 – 80
  • ⏰ Valid for 1 day
  • Includes: Pisac, Ollantaytambo, and Chinchero

Prices may vary depending on the season.

How to plan your day from Cusco

Option 1: Organized tour (recommended)

  • Round-trip transportation
  • Professional guide
  • Strategic stops
  • Buffet lunch (optional)

⏱ Duration: 8–10 hours

Option 2: Independent travel

  • Public transport or taxi
  • Greater flexibility
  • Requires advance planning

⏱ Flexible duration

Useful tips

Leave Cusco early
Bring cash for local markets
Use sunscreen and a hat
Wear comfortable clothes and a light jacket

Is the Sacred Valley worth visiting?

Absolutely. It’s the perfect complement before visiting Machu Picchu and a unique opportunity to understand the greatness of the Inca Empire.
